summary: A 5-10 s public-domain human narrator clip for the #1386 reference A/B.
description: Reference A/B (#1384 stage A), preparation: cuts one sentence out of the LibriVox recording of the Gettysburg Address read by John Greenman (https://archive.org/details/gettysburg_johng_librivox, public domain), fetched over https, and saves it as a wav. The span, 'start_seconds' to 'start_seconds' + 'duration_seconds', was placed from word timings (transcribe_audio, timestamps 'word') to hold exactly 'reference_text' with a little silence either side and none of the neighbouring sentences. Keep the output as the asset 'bench/narrator-human.wav' (keep_output) before running narration-reference-ab.json's human arm, which reads it with this same 'reference_text'.

variables.reference_text: The world will little note, nor long remember what we say here, but it can never forget what they did here.
